messages:
nora-customer: Hey team, since last deploy our dedicated pool (eu-west-2, pool-id: dp-9f4b) tenant 'acme-inc' is seeing p95 token latency spikes and intermittent 429s. Started ~08:22UTC, sustained for ~15m.

nora-customer: Quick snapshot from our side — requests get served then spike, GPU metrics show sudden SM utilization bursts on one host, and we see repeated MIG slice switching in the node logs. Not sure if autoscaler kept up.

nora-customer: example curl: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'X-Request-ID: r-8a7c'
```

sam-support: Thanks Nora — sorry for the trouble. Can you confirm if this is a Dedicated pool (reserved) or Dedicated-shared? You said pool-id dp-9f4b, that matches Reserved Dedicated. We'll triage.

nora-customer: Yes reserved. Tenant is pinned to pool dp-9f4b. No config changes on our side.

olivia-eng-sre: I'm looking at host-level telemetry now. I see a host node (host-ev13) with rapid SM% spikes, NVSM kernel busy, and MIG slot reassign events at 08:22:12 -> 08:22:38 -> 08:23:05. Pattern: short bursts every ~20s that line up with the p95 spikes. Could be co-tenant KV-cache warmup + fractional packing.

mike-runtime: Repro hypothesis: a co-located tenant is doing variable-length generation causing KV cache churn. Because the node is fractionally packed (2x 1g.5gb slices + 1x 2g slice) the longer sequences push SM and L2 activity; that thrashes shared L3 and fabric and causes tail latency spikes.

sam-support: Any quick mitigations we can try live?

olivia-eng-sre: Short-term: move acme-inc off host-ev13 to a clean slice (live migrate to dp-9f4b:host-ev21) and enable autoscale-burst (+1 slice) for 10 minutes to absorb the spike. Also temporarily set packing.policy=prefer-isolation for acme-inc.

mike-runtime: Commands we used: 
```
rictl tenant move --tenant acme-inc --from host-ev13 --to host-ev21 --pool dp-9f4b --force
rictl pool config set dp-9f4b --tenant acme-inc packing.policy=prefer-isolation
autoscale-bot: scale request accepted for dp-9f4b +1 burst slot (expires in 10m)
```

sam-support: After the move we observed p95 drop from 1.2s -> 210ms within two warmup requests. No 429s in the follow window.

nora-customer: Confirmed — latency improved, thanks! Any longer-term fix? We do have bursty long generations occasionally.

olivia-eng-sre: For long-term: 1) recommend pinning heavy generators to a 2g slice or dedicated host (isolation), 2) enable prefix KV caching and warmup for common prompts (rictl kvcache prewarm), 3) adjust fractional packing thresholds so variable-length workloads don't co-reside with short chat workloads. We'll open an eng-runbook entry and a scheduler policy change RFC.

mike-runtime: Filed infra ticket INF-5921 to add better detect-and-isolate heuristics: detect SM/L2/L3 thrash patterns and auto-evict noisy slice. Also adding a telemetry rule to trigger autoscale-burst earlier.

sam-support: Closing triage thread — mitigation applied (migration + burst) and acme-inc is stable. We'll follow up in INF-5921 with root cause and scheduler changes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
